title: Improvement recommendations
description:
Written by `feedback-synthesizer` from `pqa report --format json` and the reviewed findings it aggregates -- never from session logs or candidates. Checked by `pqa check-improvements`, which verifies that every cited fingerprint is an accepted finding in a gated run, that every quote is a persona's user_voice verbatim, and that no blocker or major defect is silently left out.

The synthesizer judges what to change, not whether anything is a defect: that was settled by qa-reviewer, and this file cannot add a defect the review did not accept.

source_runs.description: The runs the report was built from. Each must be an included (gate-passing) run.

change.description: What to change, in product terms -- what a person using the app would notice is different. Not an implementation plan: nobody in this pipeline has seen the code.

quote.description: Verbatim from a finding's user_voice (a contiguous excerpt is fine). Checked.

priority.description: Ordering for the team, not a restatement of severity: a minor defect hit by every persona can come before a major one hit by one.

open_questions.description: What a human would need to find out before acting -- usually something no run covered.

not_addressed.description: Accepted defects deliberately left out, with the reason. Required for any blocker or major defect not cited by a recommendation.
